## Summary

Describe the smallest implemented change and link the source Issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `./gradlew test`
- [ ] `./gradlew build`
- [ ] `node --test supabase/tests/security-contract.mjs`
- [ ] `scripts/lint.sh`
- [ ] `scripts/security-gate.sh`

## Human gate

- [ ] I reviewed generated changes and redacted evidence.
- [ ] No raw artifact, signed URL, or credential is present.
- [ ] I accept the remaining risks. (Agents and the dispatcher must not check this.)
